data.name: Mutate Eidolon
data.description: You can change your eidolon's evolutions as if you had gained a level. To mutate your eidolon, you must perform an arcane ritual that requires 24 hours of uninterrupted concentration and costs %1 gp in material components.|classlevel("Summoner")*200
